name: T26 — age comes from createTime, so moving a tag cannot re-age an image
_comment: GAR bumps updateTime when a tag moves off a digest. rel-old was pushed 90 days ago but had `latest` moved off it 3 days ago; under updateTime it reads as 3d and outlives every threshold. It is over the 30d tagged limit and outside the top-5 semver keep-set, so it must be deleted.
